verdicts.decision_note: The source identifies material conflicts concerning the bushing fit, screw retention, installation direction, and assembly role.
The client defines the bushing's location, exclusion from POS 4, required shaft clearance, and the control-piston rod path for the CAD model and drawings.
The client supplies an actionable arrangement that resolves the preceding bushing-assembly clarification state.
The client adds the rod-guidance function, specifies a clearance-fit example, and clarifies which assembly element occupies the sliding part.
The source and supporting context expose an unresolved choice between a freely moving shaft bushing and rigid rod retention, including the need for screw retention.

value_updates.bushing_location: secured at the sliding end and sliding inside the main shaft
value_updates.bushing_attachment: secured in the sliding end with the rod nut

verdicts.decision_note: The client replaces the prior stationary rod-guidance arrangement with a rod-nut-retained sliding bushing whose outside diameter contacts the shaft; stale guidance and piston-only-location keys are removed, and maintenance-review logistics are excluded.
The client selects an actionable bushing retention and sliding arrangement for the drawings, returning the Requirement from clarification to active work.
